title: CONTINGENCY CONTRACT: SEASON #1 BATTLEPLAN PYROLYSIS OPEN
lines: 01 CONTINGENCY CONTRACT: SEASON #1 BATTLEPLAN PYROLYSIS OPEN

SEASON DETAILS: During the season, players can combine different "Contracts" to clear stages. By completing tests, players can increase their Sanctuary Judgment scores and collect "Crystal Contract Bounty" (which can be used to exchange for rewards in the Crystallization Sanctuary). Upon completing certain "Contracts," players can also earn rewards such as the exclusive outfit for Flamebringer, Integrated Module Data Chunk, and exclusive furniture.
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Crystal Contract Bounty. Crystal Contract Bounty can be used to redeem items in Crystallization Sanctuary.
MAIN REWARDS: Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Part, etc.
◆The Crystallisation Sanctuary consists of a Special Trade Center and a Permanent Trade Center, and the Permanent Trade Center will be always open.
Please stay tuned for further information.
02 TARGETED OPERATOR HEADHUNTING OPEN: JOINT OPERATION
DETAILS: During the event, the Targeted Operator Headhunting, [Joint Operation], opens and ONLY the following Operators will appear in the 6★ and 5★ Operator List of this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★: Wind Chimes / Hibiscus the Purifier / April / Iris / Aurora / Aosta
DETAILS: All stages in Supplies and Chips stay open during the period above.
04 NEW PACK AVAILABLE FOR A LIMITED TIME
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available from the Store for a limited time.
05 EPOQUE COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
EPOQUE Collection - Ingenious Servant for Kjera
1. 'Break the Ice' Permanently Available in [Side Story]
Please stay tuned for more information!
